headline: Five booked in a week says the funnel is real. Fifty three initials a day says the machine is starving. One lever: account 2.

sections.title: Bottleneck
sections.text: Volume. 53 initials a day MEASURED against the 105 plan, with the funnel below it now measured working: booking 26.1 percent of people (23 replied, 6 booked), a whisker from the 35 baseline.

sections.title: Levers in euros
sections.text: One, account 2 live: roughly 50 more initials a day is about EUR 5,500 a month at the measured funnel (2.0 percent reply, 26 percent booking, 50 percent show, 1 of 3 close, EUR 5k cash per close ASSUMED and broken if deals go zero fee). It also un-caps follow ups, which the reply waves keep proving are the reply engine. Two, tag and work the 12 untagged replies: about 4 bookings at the 35 percent bar, roughly EUR 3,300 one time, same assumptions. Three, this week's calls executed clean: up to 4 shows queued, the nearest cash in the month. Levers overlap, never sum.

sections.title: Strategic moves
sections.text: Gates all say hold: no second setter (booking 26.1 below the 35 gate), no niche test. The one sanctioned move remains fleet completion. Pre call proof goes out before Ryan rosengren today and every call this week, per the proof vault doctrine; if the vault folder still does not exist, that is today's second job.

sections.title: What you would miss
sections.text: Pricing posture drift. Daniel at zero fee was the deliberate whale exception; four calls now queue behind it. If zero fee quietly becomes the default, August cash stays EUR 0 by design and nobody decided that on purpose.

sections.title: Do not touch
sections.text: The ladder (2,382 follow ups, up 11 percent in a half volume week, still producing reply waves). The messaging set. Pricing doctrine's EUR 10k anchor. The EOD habit, 20 straight logged send days.

sections.title: Training questions
sections.text: One: Daniel's rev share terms, what percent of what revenue and when does the first payment land? The cash forecast is blind without it. Two: for this week's four calls, what decides on the spot between the EUR 10k anchor and the zero fee whale exception? The playbook holds the exception but not the trigger.
